Harish Rao Sends Legal Notice to TPCC Chief

Telangana Minister Harish Rao has sent a legal notice to Telangana Pradesh Congress Committee (TPCC) Chief Revanth Reddy. The notice was issued in response to alleged 'misleading claims' made by Reddy. The specific nature of these claims was not detailed in the provided coverage.
